I had a very poor experience with Dallas Flash Auto Glass. The company accepted my payment but failed to provide the correct service. The wrong window was ordered and installed, and the job was never properly completed.

Despite repeated attempts to resolve the issue, the company refused to correct the mistake or refund my money. Communication was unprofessional, and accountability was completely lacking. I paid in good faith expecting competent service, but instead was left with an incorrect installation and no resolution.

This experience resulted in wasted time, financial loss, and unnecessary frustration. I would strongly advise others to exercise caution before doing business with this company, especially when it comes to upfront payments and guarantees of workmanship.
